```yaml
name: PX4 Metadata Sync

on:
  schedule:
    # Daily at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: '0 6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: px4-metadata-sync
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  sync-metadata:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Download PX4 airframes.xml
        run: |
          curl -sSL -o src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml \
            https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/airframes.xml

      - name: Download PX4 parameters.xml
        run: |
          curl -sSL -o src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml \
            https://artifacts.px4.io/Firmware/_general/parameters.xml

      - name: Check for changes
        id: git-check
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code || echo "changed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Create Pull Request
        if: steps.git-check.outputs.changed == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: update PX4 metadata from artifacts.px4.io"
          title: "chore: update PX4 metadata"
          body: |
            This PR updates the PX4 airframe and parameter metadata from artifacts.px4.io.
            
            - Updates `src/AutoPilotPlugins/PX4/AirframeFactMetaData.xml`
            - Updates `src/FirmwarePlugin/PX4/PX4ParameterFactMetaData.xml`
            
            This is an automated update triggered by the daily CI workflow.
          branch: px4-metadata-update
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
